components.text: Chapters open when a chest leaf reaches you. The cover is given on the Sky Island. Lost it — book + map.$(br)$(br)✎ Not the FTB Aeronautics Journal: that quest is still a stub.
The Sky Island sits near Y 200. Forgiving Void will return you from below if you slip, but still plank the deck. Clear Void and Smooth Skies are skybox, not flight.
